pages.text: Crushing gets more metal out of an ore block than smelting it does. This is the main reason to build $(l:create_basics/crushing)Crushing Wheels$(/l).$(br2)One ore block gives 1 crushed ore, a 75% chance of a second, experience nuggets and sometimes stone back.

pages.title: Crushing Wheel
pages.text: Feed it ore blocks (mine them with Silk Touch). About 1.75 crushed ores per block, and 2.25 for deepslate ore.
The catch: $(thing)raw ore$(), what normal mining drops, crushes to one crushed ore. No gain. Only the ore block itself doubles.$(br2)Then smelt or wash the crushed ore.
pages.title: Raw versus block
Crushed Raw Iron
pages.text: Blast it into one ingot, or wash it with a Fan into nuggets plus a chance at a byproduct. Crushed zinc works the same.
Washing means a $(l:create_basics/fans)Fan$(/l) blowing through water. Iron gives 9 nuggets and may add redstone. Check JEI for each metal's byproduct.
pages.title: Fan washing

pages.text: Create covers copper, iron, gold and zinc. Tag recipes also cover platinum, uranium, nickel and raw lead when a mod supplies them. Its recipe for lead ore blocks is off.
pages.title: Which metals

pages.text: $(li)TFMG: nickel, lithium, bauxite to powder, galena to a little lead. Its metals get a smaller bonus, about 1.25.$(li)Create Nuclear: crushed uranium to powder, thorium, nitrate.
pages.title: Add-on crushing
Crushed Raw Lithium
pages.text: TFMG's lithium ore crushes to this, then blasts to an ingot. Nickel ore crushes to Crushed Raw Nickel.

Create Propulsion adds platinum, Iron's Spells mithril. Northstar planet ores crush at the full rate into raw items, for example raw titanium. Raw titanium smelts straight to an ingot. Venus coal ore crushes to extra coal.
pages.title: Northstar
Raw Titanium
pages.text: Crush any planet's titanium ore for about 1.75 of these, then smelt or blast. $(l:space/planets)Planets$(/l)
Aether zanite and ambrosium ores give 1.75 gems or shards each.$(br2)No crushing recipes exist for Alex's Caves, Better End or Twilight Forest ores; smelt them as normal.
